messages.text: The exact browser evidence shows the app rendered cleanly, but search navigation was racing on each controlled keystroke and the mobile-only drawer test was incorrectly running in the desktop project. I’m making search state immediate and URL synchronization debounced, pinning the mobile profile to Chromium, and scoping the drawer assertion to the mobile project; these changes address the real behavior and test contract rather than merely increasing timeouts.

commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch *** Update File: src/components/Storefront.tsx @@ const navigate = useNavigate({ from: '/' }) const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(Boolean(search.q)) + const [query, setQuery] = useState(search.q) @@ const update = (next: Partial) => navigate({ search: (old) => ({ ...old, ...next }), replace: true }) @@ - return update({ category, favorites: false })} onSearch={() => setSearchOpen(true)}> + useEffect(() => { + if (query === search.q) return + const timeout = setTimeout(() => update({ q: query }), 220) + return () => clearTimeout(timeout) + }, [query, search.q]) + return update({ category, favorites: false })} onSearch={() => setSearchOpen(true)}> @@ -
update({ q: e.target.value })} placeholder='Search prompts — “portrait”, “writing”, “brand”' aria-label="Search prompts"/>
+
setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder='Search prompts — “portrait”, “writing”, “brand”' aria-label="Search prompts"/>
*** Update File: playwright.config.ts @@ - projects: [{ name: 'chromium', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] } }, { name: 'mobile', use: { ...devices['iPhone 13'] } }], + projects: [{ name: 'chromium', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] } }, { name: 'mobile', use: { ...devices['iPhone 13'], browserName: 'chromium' } }], *** Update File: tests/e2e/marketplace.spec.ts @@ -test('mobile drawer and dock remain usable', async ({ page }) => { +test('mobile drawer and dock remain usable', async ({ page, isMobile }) => { + test.skip(!isMobile, 'Mobile-only navigation contract') *** End Patch
